build_mask_split_shape_texture: build a binary mask to split a latent vector into shape and texture network inputs
build_mask_split_mixed_noise: build a mask split with mixed noise enabled so both shape and texture use all noise dimensions
build_mask_split_conditional: build a mask split that assigns conditional attributes to shape or texture networks using keySplits
build_mask_split_simple: build a basic mask split with no conditional attributes for a simple shape and texture GAN
review_buildMaskSplit: review the buildMaskSplit function to understand how latent vectors are split into shape and texture masks
